details.title: AI Call Agent for Shopping Mall Information Retrieval (Final Year Project)
details.description: Built a voice-based AI agent for shopping mall inquiries using OpenAI, LangChain, and Python. Implemented agentic workflows to interpret natural-language queries and dynamically query SQL databases. Integrated OpenAI Whisper, TTS, and VAD for real-time, hands-free voice conversations. Connected the agent to a SQL database and built the backend with FastAPI and modular API integrations.

details.title: Face Detection & Automated Email Responder
details.description: Built a real-time face recognition system using ResNet18 and PyTorch. Used MTCNN and OpenCV for face detection, cropping, and real-time face tracking. Trained the model with data augmentation to improve recognition accuracy. Automated email notifications based on the detected person's identity.

details.title: AI Job Application & Job Aggregation System

Processed job titles, companies, locations, skills, and requirements for efficient search and matching.
